environment.description: Container runs under a custom AppArmor profile (k8s-webhook-delivery) loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/webhook=localhost/k8s-webhook-delivery. The profile denies all network connect() calls except to destinations matching the pod's own subnet CIDR (10.244.0.0/16) and explicitly listed external webhook receiver IPs in /etc/apparmor.d/tunables/webhook-allowlist. Additionally, the node runs with an iptables DNAT rule that redirects any traffic from the pod's cgroup to 169.254.169.254 into a blackhole (DROP). The AppArmor profile also includes 'deny network raw,' preventing raw socket creation that could bypass connect() filtering. Profile was generated via bpfman trace and tightened with aa-logprof over a 30-day observation window.

config.imds_version: v2 (token required, but moot due to network block)
